items.source: Uses of BooleanComparator in org.springframework.util.comparator
items.translation: `org.springframework.util.comparator` 包中 `BooleanComparator` 的用法

items.source: A shared default instance of this comparator, treating true higher than false.
items.translation: 此比较器的共享默认实例，将 `true` 视为高于 `false`。

items.source: A shared default instance of this comparator, treating true lower than false.
items.translation: 此比较器的共享默认实例，将 `true` 视为低于 `false`。

items.source: Useful generic java.util.Comparator implementations, such as an invertible comparator and a compound comparator.
items.translation: 有用的通用 `java.util.Comparator` 实现，例如可逆比较器和组合比较器。
